A '''Human male''' served as the leader of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]' [[Lizard Keeper]]s in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], who was on a [[Mission to Dathomir (Post–Naboo crisis)|mission to Dathomir]].
